project_type: Monorepo-style: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite SPA frontend (existing) plus a new Node.js + TypeScript + Fastify backend with PostgreSQL. Goal: replace the frontend-only localStorage data layer with a real server (REST + WebSocket) while preserving the existing synchronous Repository contract and reusing the pure domain logic.
build_system: npm. Frontend at repo root (/projects/sandbox/hello-talk). New backend to live in a subdirectory (server/) with its own package.json. Node v22.23.2, npm 11.4.2 available. nvm has 24/22/20/18.
test_framework: Frontend: vitest run (jsdom, globals, setupFiles ./src/test/setup.ts, include src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}). 61 tests across 4 files currently pass. Backend: use vitest or node:test — vitest recommended for consistency. Backend integration tests must run against a real PostgreSQL (Docker) covering auth, friends, chats, messaging, read state, gift lifecycle, idempotency, and server-side authorization enforcement.
build_command: Frontend: `npm run build` at repo root (runs `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build`). Backend: `npm run build` inside server/ (tsc emit) plus `npm run typecheck`.
test_command: Frontend: `npm test` at repo root (vitest run). Backend: `npm test` inside server/ (vitest run) — requires a reachable PostgreSQL; start one with the provided docker script first.
verification_instructions: 1) Frontend baseline: `npm ci && npm test && npm run build && npm run typecheck` at repo root — all must pass (61 existing tests unchanged). 2) Backend: start Postgres via `docker run` helper, then in server/: `npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test`. 3) E2E: start Postgres, start backend, run `npm run dev` (or preview) for frontend pointed at the backend, and exercise create user -> add friend -> open direct chat -> send/receive message with read state -> send gift -> run gift lifecycle across two browser sessions/tabs. Document exact commands used.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No snapshot/golden files. Frontend build output is dist/ (gitignored). Backend build output should also be gitignored (e.g., server/dist/).
setup_instructions: Node available. PostgreSQL server is NOT installed on the host. Docker daemon IS running and `docker pull postgres:16-alpine` succeeds. `docker compose` plugin is NOT available — use plain `docker run` (wrap in a helper script such as server/scripts/db.sh) to start/stop a local Postgres container: e.g. `docker run --name hello-talk-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=hello_talk -p 5432:5432 -d postgres:16-alpine`. Network mode is OPEN_INTERNET so npm installs and docker pulls work. Terraform CLI is NOT installed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET (npm + docker pull allowed). PostgreSQL not on host — must run via Docker `docker run` (NO docker-compose plugin). Backend integration tests need a running Postgres; if the container is unavailable at test time, tests must fail loudly rather than silently skip — but under this sandbox Docker Postgres is available and is the required path. Terraform not installed, so backend IaC/deployment is documented, not applied. The AWS backend compute service is NOT decided — do not invent one; document deployment as deferred.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT commit the untracked .kiro/ directory (user explicitly forbade committing .kiro docs). Work on a feature branch; commit all other changes. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator publishes). Demo user names must remain the established pseudonyms (홍길동/김철수/이영희/박영수) — do not import real names. Do NOT expose the demo-only FORCE_EXPIRE gift action in the production server API.
key_patterns: CRITICAL: the Repository interface (src/store/repository.ts) is FULLY SYNCHRONOUS. UI code reads return values immediately and synchronously: repo.createUser(name).id, repo.openDirectChat(a,b) returns ChatId, repo.sendGift(...) returns {ok, orderId, chatId} read inline, repo.addFriendByCode(...) returns {ok, friend, reason}, repo.giftAction(...) returns {ok, text|reason}, snapshot() returns Db synchronously, subscribe(listener) drives useSyncExternalStore. Therefore ApiRepository MUST maintain an in-memory Db mirror hydrated from the server (initial snapshot fetch) and kept live via WebSocket pushes, and mutating methods must update the mirror optimistically/synchronously while firing async HTTP requests, reconciling on WS/HTTP responses. Do NOT change the Repository interface signatures — changing them would ripple into every screen. Pure domain modules (src/domain/gift.ts, selectors.ts, types.ts, products.ts, ids.ts) know nothing about DOM/React/storage and are meant to be reused verbatim on the server. Design decisions to preserve server-side: friendships are DIRECTIONAL; direct chats are UNIQUE per pair (openDirectChat is idempotent); unread is computed from a single per-room lastReadAt, never stored as a counter; gift 'expired' and 'draft'/'cancelled' are computed/derived not stored (stored statuses: paid|accepted|used|refunded); gift authorization + settlement rules live ONLY in checkGiftAction/applyGiftAction and must be reused, not reimplemented. Server session is the sole source of actor identity — never trust client-supplied user/actor IDs for authorization.

src/domain/selectors.ts (directChatBetween, unreadCount, isFriend, findUserByCode, normalizeCode, etc.)
src/domain/products.ts (24-item static catalog; productById; not stored in Db)

src/features/chats/ChatRoomScreen.tsx (markRead effect, sendMessage, gift bubbles, read receipts)
src/features/gift/SendGiftSheet.tsx, GiftBubble.tsx, VoucherSheet.tsx (sendGift/giftAction usage incl. FORCE_EXPIRE demo button)
src/store/localRepository.test.ts, src/store/localRepository.gift.test.ts, src/domain/gift.test.ts, src/domain/selectors.test.ts (61 tests that MUST still pass)
tsconfig.json (strict, verbatimModuleSyntax, isolatedModules, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, moduleResolution bundler)
README.md (authoritative design rationale for all the invariants above)
directory_structure: Repo root /projects/sandbox/hello-talk: src/ (domain/, store/, features/{auth,chats,friends,gift,more,shell}, ui/), infra-tf/ (Terraform for S3+CloudFront frontend hosting), prototypes/, references/, dist/. New backend goes in server/ (its own package.json, src/, tests). Shared domain code (src/domain/*) should be reused by the server via a path/import strategy rather than duplicated.
